scientific_integrity: The classical unmarked Poisson(2) overlap law and forest-count formula are credited to prior literature. The new statement is the conditional four-degree law and the marked spatial Poisson limit, with a separately proved exact finite conditional generating function.
scientific_limitations: Only two independent uniform labeled Cayley trees are covered; no arbitrary host-graph extension is proved.
Point-process conclusions use fixed-degree marks and fixed spatial windows; no uniform growing-degree bound is claimed.
The classical 1986 paper is known by its year and month, but its exact day and full text were unavailable; the 1999 paper provides the earliest directly verified exact-day public source date.
Independent mathematical and historical validation have not been performed.
title: A degree-marked Poisson process for common edges of independent random labeled trees
